## Intent — what this is for

An HONESTY atom over WF2LOO-1's deliverable, not a feature atom: it makes what judge_contract.py SAYS match what the code DOES, and deliberately builds none of the missing wiring. The module opens by stating 'A PASS without cited proof is invalid ... the verdict is rejected by the contract' as fact; measured, its six enforcement entry points (validate_verdict, meets_ratchet, compute_overall, detect_forbidden_modes, aggregate_samples, hints_from_dict) have ZERO production callers, and the live judge gate asks for EXACTLY ONE word parsed by verify.parse_verdict over a DIFFERENT enum, so no live response can carry proof, scores or a rubric result. Enforcing the headline would invalidate every judge PASS in all 7 shipped judge gates, which is an outage rather than a gate, so the docstring is what changes. No function is deleted; no judge gate becomes stricter; engine.py and verify.py stay byte-identical. Records WF2LOO-13 as the scoped wiring work.

## Done when

judge_contract.py's docstring stops asserting live enforcement and records the measurement instead: six enforcement entry points with zero production callers, both live judge paths named (the one-word GateKind.JUDGE gate read by verify.parse_verdict; the contract-shaped judge STAGE in 6 templates whose output dispatch_infer parses and nothing reads or validates), the rubric's prose-only reachability, and what wiring would take. One rail (test_workflows_judge_contract.py::test_the_unwired_enforcement_claim_matches_the_live_path) fails in BOTH drift directions - enforcement gaining a production caller while the docstring still says it has none, and the live gate leaving its one-word prompt while the docstring still gives that as the reason - with two vacuity floors (entry points must still be defined; the judge branch must be found before concluding anything from the gate's text), proven able to fail by three probes (marker removed; injected validate_verdict caller in verify.py; gate prompt switched to JSON) each reverted by a targeted edit. engine.py and verify.py byte-identical to HEAD, so a user's judge gate behaves exactly as before. WF2LOO-13 recorded with its measured blast radius.
